# Workflow limits

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @openverify/api workflow-docs:write`: edit the code, not this file. -->

Every constant is provisional unless its basis says otherwise, and no limit was tuned on test data. Exceeding one is its code, never a truncated answer. The definition limits answer `definition_invalid` at save or publish.

## Runs

| Limit | Value | Basis | Code | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wait-seconds` | 2592000 | public | `definition_invalid` | docs/research/phase8-behaviour.md 1.8: 30 days, both kinds of wait |
| `loop-items` | 100 | public | `loop_limit_exceeded` | C117.7; phase8-behaviour.md 1.3: a longer list errors |
| `step-executions` | 5000 | provisional | `step_limit_exceeded` | C117.7: loops and retries included |
| `run-duration-seconds` | 7776000 | provisional | `run_deadline_exceeded` | C117.7: the default event retention |
| `run-depth` | 5 | provisional | `run_depth_exceeded` | C117.7: Run Workflow and Schedule Workflow |
| `event-fanout` | 50 | provisional | `publish_trigger_fanout_exceeded` | C117.7: workflows started by one event |
| `subjects` | 1000 | provisional | `subjects_overflow` | C117.7, C120.9: past it the run is marked overflowed |
| `trigger-depth` | 8 | provisional | `trigger_depth_exceeded` | C117.7, C118.8: causality depth |
| `trigger-snapshot-bytes` | 262144 | provisional | `payload_too_large` | C117.7: an event document with its included |
| `step-output-bytes` | 65536 | provisional | `payload_too_large` | C117.7: a step output journaled |
| `variables-bytes` | 1048576 | provisional | `payload_too_large` | C115.4, C117.7: all of a run |
| `step-claims` | 10 | provisional | `execution_error` | C117.4: the C74.1 crash-loop cap |
| `redactions-per-run` | 100 | provisional | `redaction_limit_exceeded` | C127.8 (decision 42) |

A run that would record more than the `subjects` limit is marked `subjects_overflow`, and any redaction in its environment then also nulls that run’s values, whoever it was about (C120.9).
